title: Pasulka and Vallee: aliens as the modern form of angels and demons

tellings.quote: there's a religious studies Professor named Diana Pula and there's a guy named jacqu Val this French ufologist both of whom believe that aliens are sort of the Contemporary version of Angels and Demons

plain: Aliens may be the present-day version of the angels and demons of older religion, according to the idea Michels credits to two people: a religious studies professor named Diana Pasulka and a French ufologist, someone who studies UFOs, named Jacques Vallée. Michels sums up their view himself, saying both "believe that aliens are sort of the Contemporary version of Angels and Demons." If they are right, today's UFO encounters would be a new face of something people have met throughout history.
